description.value:
Your connection to your wellspring of magic grows, allowing you to call upon an even greater repository of eidolons for aid. Add an additional eidolon to your assembly; this eidolon can be of your tradition, or any non-opposing tradition. For instance, an arcane convoker could select an arcane, primal, or occult eidolon, but not a divine eidolon. If you choose an eidolon from a tradition other than your own, it is considered an eidolon of that tradition for the sake of feats and prerequisites.

Special You can select this feat two additional times, gaining an additional eidolon to add to your assembly.

rules.prompt: Choose the eidolon to add to your assembly.
